conviction_note: Near non-result: the FY2026 quarter is visible from the 9M 進捗率 (revenue ~4% short of plan, profit near plan), the only real unknown is the first FY2027 guide, where management's own 'FY2026 is the start year of up-front investment' and a Q3 OP of +24% y/y lean toward a recovery guide, set against a 667k-share margin long (about 10% of float) left over from an unexplained +14% spike on 9/15. The findings sum to +0.3; the scaled number is 52/50 on 4.0, because last year's FY guide moved the stock -14.5% and the sign of this year's guide is inference, not a document.
bar: Company plan FY2026 (Aug): revenue 12,576m, OP 1,804m, ordinary 1,888m, NP 1,306m, DPS 30, unchanged since 2025-10-09 and reaffirmed in the Q3 短信 2026-07-09 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589726.pdf). No IFIS/analyst consensus exists (kabuyoho shows '--', https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9414); 四季報 FY2027 figure not reachable. print_vs_bar is ordinary profit vs plan (my estimate ~1,850-1,870 if Q4 matches Q3's 490m); revenue would be about -4% (Q4 needs 3,725m against a record quarter of 3,414m). FY2027 guide has no sourced bar, so the guidance finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用残 from kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9414): margin long 397.2k (9/11) -> 676.8k (9/18) -> 770.0k (9/25) -> 666.6k (10/02); margin short 14.5k; 信用倍率 45.97. 666.6k = ~3.7% of 17.83m shares, ~10% of the ~6.9m float (BicCamera holds 61.29%), and ~13-15 sessions of recent volume. No option skew exists. A crowded margin long, so a disappointment has sellers and a good number meets supply from 9/15-9/18 buyers at 980-1050.

findings.finding: The first FY2027 (Aug-27) guide lands with this print. Management called FY2026 'the start year of structural revenue reform, with up-front investment' (H1 call script), the investment was already in the base by Q3, and Q3 standalone OP was 477m (+23.9% y/y) against a Q4 comp of 388m, so a guide for profit recovery and, under the ~40% payout rule, a possible 1-2 yen dividend increase is more likely than a repeat of last year's decline guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last FY print (2025-10-09, FY2026 guide of OP -6.6% with H1 OP -28.4%, plus a CEO change) was followed by -14.47% (baseline history, 2025-10-10). The 2024-10-10 FY print with a growth year behind it moved -1.0%. Q3 print 2026-07-09 (Q3 OP +24% y/y) moved -0.9% the next day (Yahoo bars 924 -> 916).
findings.why_not_priced: With no analyst consensus and no 四季報 number reachable, nobody has published a FY2027 number. The stock trades at PER 12.8 on the declining FY2026 EPS and PBR 0.67, and it has given back the 9/15 spike (1050 -> 938). If a recovery guide were priced, it would not be sitting at the pre-spike level on a 5-day run-up of -2.4%.
findings.independence: Q3 quarterly figures from a different document: kabutan 3ヵ月決算 table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9414) and the Q3 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589726.pdf); payout-40% policy in the Q3 補足資料 p.19 (https://corp.bs11.jp/ja/ir/library/results/main/00/teaserItems1/0113/linkList/0/link/2026.8-3Q_hosokusetsumeisiryou.pdf). Same company, so this is corroboration and not independence. FISCO memo 2026-06-05 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9414&b=n202606050767) frames FY2026 as an investment year.

findings.finding: FY2026 revenue will come in about 3-4% below the 12,576m plan: 9M revenue was 8,851m (+1.2%), so the plan needs a Q4 of 3,725m against a record quarter of 3,414m. Profit lands near plan, with ordinary at about 1,850-1,870m against 1,888m, because Q4 only needs to match Q3's 490m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY2025 finished at 97.7% of its ordinary-profit plan and was part of the -14.47% print, but that print carried a decline guide. The quarter alone has not moved this stock more than ~1-2% (baseline median 1.52%).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: anyone can compute it from the 9M 短信 (ordinary progress 72.4% vs 77.1% last year, kabuyoho https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=9414), and no 修正 was filed because the miss is well inside the 10%/30% thresholds. It is filed because it is a sourced fact about this print; sized near zero for that reason.
findings.independence: kabuyoho progress table (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=9414) is computed from the same 短信, so it adds nothing independent.

findings.finding: A 666.6k-share margin long (信用倍率 45.97, ~10% of float, ~13-15 sessions of volume) built around an unexplained +14.3% spike on 2026-09-15 (1.11m shares traded vs ~20k normal; no disclosure or news on kabutan) sits above a price that has fallen back to 938. Holders underwater from 980-1050 are supply into any good news and sellers on any disappointment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior case on this name. The margin long was already 397-533k before the spike, so part of it is the name's normal state.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the baseline's own margin_overhang component is -0.83, so this mostly agrees with priced_lean. What it adds is the cost basis (spike buyers at 980-1050) and the fact that the long has not been unwound (770k -> 667k only). Sized small because it agrees with the lean.
findings.independence: Price/volume from Yahoo bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/9414.T?range=6mo&interval=1d) and kabutan's 9/15 gainers list (https://kabutan.jp/news/marketnews/?b=n202609150880), which lists ＢＳ１１ +14.3% at 1050 with no reason attached.

searched_and_found_nothing: TDnet lists for 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08 (https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/I_list_001_20261008.html): no 9414 disclosure, so there was no pre-release 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想の修正

Cause of the +14.3% move on 2026-09-15: kabutan stock news, 9/15-9/16 market news pages, and ranking articles (https://kabutan.jp/news/marketnews/?b=n202609150875). No reason found, so it is worth 0 as evidence (parent-subsidiary TOB speculation is possible but unsourced)
Analyst consensus / 四季報 FY2027 forecast: kabuyoho shows no consensus (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9414), and web search found no 四季報 number
kabutan 信用残 history page (https://kabutan.jp/stock/kabuka?code=9414&ashi=shin): CAPTCHA, so I used the 5-week table on the main page
Parent BicCamera (3048) reports 2026-10-09 per kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3048). Nothing found tying it to 9414; release time not checked
Buyback history: none found in the disclosure lists for 2024-2026 (kabutan nmode=3 pages 1-7)
release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9414&nmode=3 — Q1/H1/Q3 短信 all stamped 15:30 (2026-01-08, 04-09, 07-09); FY2025 短信 2025-10-09. A 15:30 release means the window runs from the 10/08 close to the 10/09 close
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none filed before the print; FY2026 actual will show revenue ~4% short and profit ~at plan, visible from 9M. Returns: payout ~40% policy, DPS 30 for three years; FY2027 DPS 30-32 likely, no buyback history. New-year guide: FY2027 first guide is the main item, with no external bar; last year's decline guide moved the stock -14.5%. Quarter vs own 進捗率: ordinary 72.4% at 9M vs 77.1% (FY25) and 74.4%-of-actual (FY24), consistent with a small miss

rejected_candidates.candidate: Separate capital_return finding for a 1-2 yen dividend increase
rejected_candidates.detail: Under the 40% payout rule it depends entirely on the FY2027 EPS guide, so it is merged into the guidance finding

baseline_tension: Mixed: the margin-overhang finding agrees with the baseline's -1.0 priced lean, and the guidance lean cuts against it. The strongest positive the release could carry is a profit-growth FY2027 guide with a 32-yen dividend, which I looked for and could not source. The strongest negative is a second year of investment-driven decline guidance, as on 2025-10-09 (-14.5%). Neither is documented, so p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative that rests on a public 進捗率 is held by the price): visible revenue-miss finding -0.2 -> -0.1

Rule 2 (check the sign of negatives; name the strongest positive): re-read the margin-overhang negative, found it largely duplicates the baseline's own margin_overhang lean component (-0.83), cut -0.6 -> -0.4; p_up 50 -> 52 because the guidance positive was looked for and is the only item with an asymmetric story
Left standing: the guidance finding (+0.8) and abs_move_pct 4.0
